content: जामित्रम् The seventh zodiacal sign from the natal sign (लग्न); तिथौ च जामित्रगुणान्वितायाम् <ls>Ku. 7. 1</ls> (जामित्रं लग्नात् सप्तमं स्थानम् <ls>Malli.</ls>). {%Note%}:-- Some derive the word from जाया, because in astrology, the {@जामित्र@} sign indicates the future good-luck of oneʼs wife (जायामित्रम् ?); but the word is obviously connected with the Greek {%diametron%}.
